name: Ricardo Velez
bio:
Ricardo's motorsport journey began unexpectedly, tinkering with engines on his family's coffee farm in Colombia. What started as a hobby quickly became a passion, leading him to pursue mechanical engineering. He honed his skills with smaller rally teams before catching the eye of Mitsubishi Motorsport. Ricardo emphasizes a collaborative approach, believing that the best solutions emerge from diverse perspectives. His calm demeanor under pressure and ability to simplify complex problems are his hallmarks. 

Ricardo's tenure with Mitsubishi has been marked by a focus on reliability and incremental improvements. He values a deep understanding of the vehicle's systems and fosters a culture of continuous learning within his team. While he appreciates cutting-edge technology, he believes in a balanced approach, ensuring that innovation serves the team's overall goals.

physical.description: A lean man with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a collection of miniature rally cars on his desk.
Insists on tasting the team's coffee every morning before starting work.
